program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (23.0, 16.0, 27.0),    # bottom pair: weak inversion -> low Vdsat, saturates at ~4UT
    "L1":    (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),       # long L: high ro2, good matching
    "gmid3": (24.0, 16.0, 27.0),    # cascodes in weak inversion: low Vdsat for compliance
    "L3":    (2.5, 0.5, 6.0),       # long cascode L: large gm4*ro4
    "vds1":  (0.11, 0.08, 0.13),    # bottom Vds: just above weak-inversion saturation
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # matched bottom devices, both biased at ~vds1 through the shared cascode gate
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=vds1)

    # cascodes, source at vds1 (body effect included)
    vds3 = max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.1)
    vds4 = vout - vds1
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=vds3, vsb=vds1)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=vds4, vsb=vds1)

    # cascode gate = Vgs1 + I*R = vds1 + Vgs3  ->  R
    R = (vds1 + m3.vgs - m1.vgs) / I
    R = min(max(R, 100.0), 1e6)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.R("RB", "iin", "a", R)
    n.dev("M3", "a", "iin", "x1", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "a", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "a", "vss", "vss", m2)

    # predictions
    gds2 = max(m2.gds, 1e-12)
    gds4 = max(m4.gds, 1e-12)
    A4 = (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) / gds4
    rout = A4 / gds2 + 1.0 / gds2
    # systematic error: the cascode Vds mismatch leaks to x2 through the finite cascode gain
    dx = (vds4 - vds3) / max(A4, 1.0)
    err = 100.0 * gds2 * abs(dx) / I + 0.1
    # compliance: M2 needs ~3UT to hold 95% of the current; M4 needs about its Vdsat
    vcomp = 3.0 * UT + 0.8 * m4.vdsat
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp,
               "power": 1.8 * I}
